column1: # GT-PCAP labels for dnp3-sa-failed-before-ack.pcap (D6, plan sections 1, 2B, 2C and 4). desk until reviewed by D4 and D2.
# labeller: TShark (Wireshark) 4.2.2 (Git v4.2.2 packaged as 4.2.2-1.1build3).; options: (none); gtlabel.py applies C13 section 4's rules to tshark's fields.

# fields: frame.number, frame.len, ip.src, ip.dst, tcp.srcport, tcp.dstport, tcp.flags.syn, tcp.flags.ack, dnp3.ctl.dir, dnp3.al.func, dnp3.al.seq, dnp3.al.obj, dnp3.al.fragment.reassembled.length. objects are dnp3.al.obj as g<group>v<variation>, sorted.
# a DNP3 frame is the master's when dnp3.ctl.dir is set and the outstation's when it is clear, whichever end of the flow sent first; a service row's server is the outstation's end.
# objects '?': the request's APDU is longer than its 2-octet header, but this tshark dissects no object header in it (function 22 in 4.2.2). Unlabelled: the checker compares the code only.
# sa_reply_timeout_ms: 5000 (C13 default). sa empty means unknown.
# group 120 objects are synthetic at header level (no SA specification is held): only their headers are labelled.
# frames are 1-based tshark frame numbers; frame_sha256 hashes each frame's link-layer bytes, no record header.
# case rules: every rule D4's note expects; empty is a near-miss that must raise nothing.
# counter rows: the difference between the heartbeats that bracket this capture's replay (D1 on #548).
